name: Dow
tagline: Leading materials science company serving high-growth markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Le segment Packaging & Specialty Plastics represente environ la moitie des ventes de Dow et concentre l'essentiel de l'exposition au cycle du polyethylene. C'est le KPI qui pilote la trajectoire de l'entreprise et le plus suivi par les investisseurs.

kpis.signal: Volumes en baisse de 2% au T1-2026, demande industrielle atone prolongée.
kpis.description: Croissance des volumes vendus, mesure la demande reelle en produits chimiques independamment des prix.

kpis.signal: Prix local en recul de 7% à/a au T1-2026, pression persistante sur le pouvoir de fixation des prix.
kpis.description: Evolution des prix en monnaie locale, determinant majeur des marges dans la chimie cyclique.

kpis.short: Currency impact on net sales year-over-year
kpis.signal: Le change ajoute 3% aux ventes au T1-2026, premier vent favorable notable depuis 2021.

kpis.short: Polyethylene integrated margin improvement in Q2 guidance

risks.title: Macroeconomic Recession
risks.score_rationale: Company explicitly references macroeconomic uncertainty and supply-demand dynamics as factors impacting sales across all segments and regions. 7% revenue decline demonstrates direct exposure to economic cycles. Citation: "Global Economic Considerations: The Company operates in a global, competitive environment which gives rise to". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Economic recession could further deteriorate sales and profitability, particularly given existing demand weakness

risks.title: Concurrence
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in competitive markets with local price declines driven by supply-demand dynamics, indicating pricing pressure and margin compression risk Citation: "Increased levels of competition have resulted in lower prices and lower sales volume, which have". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competitive market dynamics could erode market share and price realization

risks.title: Risque réglementaire
risks.score_rationale: Company subject to environmental and safety regulations; no material regulatory violation disclosed but ongoing compliance costs represent operational risk Citation: "The Company's global business operations also give rise to market risk exposure related to changes". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Regulatory changes could increase operational costs and constrain manufacturing flexibility

risks.title: Credit Rating Downgrade
risks.score_rationale: Company's financial leverage and declining earnings create risk of credit rating downgrade, which would increase borrowing costs and access constraints Citation: "Adverse economic conditions, a contraction in the availability of credit in the marketplace, or changes". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Credit rating downgrade would increase cost of debt financing and limit financial flexibility

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Primary exposures to natural gas, crude oil, ethylene and propylene feedstocks create significant margin volatility that cannot always be hedged effectively Citation: "The Company's global business operations also give rise to market risk exposure related to changes". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Commodity price fluctuations directly impact production costs and profitability

risks.title: Risque de contentieux
risks.score_rationale: Company (through Union Carbide) faces ongoing asbestos litigation with 7,158 unresolved claims as of Dec 31, 2025, increasing from 5,813 in 2024 Citation: "CLIMATE CHANGE - RELATED RISKS Climate Change: Climate change-related risks and uncertainties, legal or regulatory". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Asbestos litigation and other legal proceedings could result in material financial liabilities and reputational damage

risks.title: Risque de réputation
risks.score_rationale: Asbestos liabilities and environmental regulations create ongoing reputational exposure that could impact stakeholder confidence Citation: "CLIMATE CHANGE - RELATED RISKS Climate Change: Climate change-related risks and uncertainties, legal or regulatory". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reputational damage could affect customer relationships and investor confidence

company_description: Dow Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides various materials science solutions for packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, India, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The company operates through Packaging & Specialty Plastics, Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure, and Performance Materials & Coatings segments. The Packaging & Specialty Plastics segment provides ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, and aromatics products; and other ethylene derivatives, such as polyolefin elastomers, ethylene vinyl acetate, and ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber. The Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure segment offers polyurethanes, including propylene oxide, propylene glycol, and polyether polyols; aromatic isocyanates and fully formulated polyurethane systems; and chlor-alkali and vinyl comprising chlorine and caustic soda, ethylene dichloride, and vinyl chloride monomer; and construction chemicals consisting of cellulose ethers, redispersible latex powders, and acrylic emulsions, as well as coatings, adhesives, sealants, elastomers, and composites.
